pumac-2009-number-theory-a-07.prompt: Let $S=\{p/q\mid q\le2009,\ p/q<1257/2009,\ p,q\in\mathbb N\}$. If the maximum element of $S$ is $p_0/q_0$ in reduced form, find $p_0+q_0$.

pumac-2009-number-theory-a-08.prompt: Find the largest positive integer $k$ such that $\varphi(\sigma(2^k))=2^k$. ($\varphi(n)$ denotes the number of positive integers that are smaller than $n$ and relatively prime to $n$, and $\sigma(n)$ denotes the sum of divisors of $n$.) As a hint, you are given that $641\mid2^{32}+1$.
